summary: Configured persistent, filtered BGP transit through SONiC node1 (AS 65100) between node2 (AS 65101) and node3 (AS 65102). Management remains separate. All nodes were restarted serially, showed changed boot IDs, and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Configured peer-a as 172.20.1.0/31 and peer-b as 172.20.2.0/31.
Created stable endpoints 192.0.2.1/32 on node2 and 198.51.100.1/32 on node3.
Applied strict BGP import/export filters so each Ubuntu peer originates exactly its endpoint prefix.
Enabled persistent SONiC forwarding, link configuration, and post-BGP-start policy application.
Verified bidirectional endpoint-sourced traffic without address translation.
Restarted each node individually and verified recovery; node1 received an additional serial validation restart after correcting SONiC boot-time FRR regeneration behavior.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated links with management outside the data plane
evidence.summary: Management remains on node1 eth0 and peer enp1s0 interfaces, while transit uses node1 eth1/eth2 and peer enp8s0 interfaces.

evidence.requirement: Correct AS topology and one-prefix-only origination
evidence.summary: AS 65100 has both filtered neighbors; node2 advertises only 192.0.2.1/32 and node3 only 198.51.100.1/32. Each adjacency is established with one prefix received and sent.

evidence.requirement: Bidirectional transit preserving endpoint source addresses
evidence.summary: Both endpoint-sourced directions succeed with 0% loss. Post-restart captures on node1 eth1 and eth2 show unchanged 192.0.2.1↔198.51.100.1 addresses.

Healthy baseline used boot ba637597…; reboot was acknowledged; boot changed to 0d778965…. Persistent link and FRR-policy services started automatically, both BGP routes recovered, and transit/source preservation was re-proven.
Boot changed from 3fad4432… to 9d7ed9b9…. FRR, networkd, endpoint addressing, BGP route exchange, and endpoint transit recovered.
Boot changed from 4d70780a… to c7ade43e…. FRR, networkd, endpoint addressing, BGP route exchange, and reverse endpoint transit recovered.
